summary: Inspected all 183 changed/added files in the leanprover-community__batteries repository. No CI/maintenance scripts other than the already-excluded scripts/check_imports.lean are present. Per FILTER-002/004/021/025, the high evidence bar for hard exclusion is unmet; default retain applies to all files.
